sources.entry: OSSN - Social networking software that allows you to make a social networking website and helps your members build social relationships, with people who share similar professional or personal interests. (Source Code) CAL-1.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: OSSN (Open Source Social Network) is a PHP social networking software for building a community website where members form social connections around shared interests.
summary.what_it_does: OSSN is a PHP application for creating a social networking website with member profiles, friends, and community features. The README lists front-end features including user registration and login, profiles with cover and photos, friends management, live chat and messaging, wall posts, albums, groups, comments with likes and reactions, notifications, search, blogs, and a progressive web app. The admin side includes a dashboard with online-user and gender graphs, user add/edit/remove and validation, an ads manager, cache and basic settings, a menu builder, custom pages, themes, and components management, plus a WebServices API. The README says the interface is available in many languages, including English, French, Spanish, German, Japanese, and Persian. Installation is described as a web installer, Docker, or a VM image, and an Ubuntu PPA package is given.
use_cases: run a private or public social network website
host a members-only social platform for an organization
notable: Broad feature set covering profiles, groups, albums, chat, blogs, and reactions
Multiple language support with over 20 languages listed
Admin dashboard with user management, ads manager, and menu builder
Progressive Web App support and Microsoft Active Directory login
caveats: The install directory must be writable by the webserver, and the README gives Apache-specific permission steps; other webservers need separate setup
The Ubuntu package instructions cover only Ubuntu x64 LTS releases listed in the README
The license is a combined OSSN license and Cryptographic Autonomy License, which may need review before commercial use
keywords: connect with people who share interests
run my own social media site
